_what: The governor's corrections as checks. Every rule here is applied by e2e/14-whole-app.spec.ts to every page the app has (found from src/app/**/page.tsx), signed out, as a maker and as the operator, on phone and desktop. A rule is added when a correction is made (skill: .claude/skills/gallery-app-sweep), proved to fail on the offending screen, and only then the screens are fixed. Rules are never deleted to make a sweep pass; a rule that is wrong is changed with the governor's word and the change is recorded in the ledger.

rules.says: The Gallery names no city of its own; a place is only a maker's own field.
Monospace is for labels, counts and addresses. A sentence is never set in mono.
rules.source: governor review of the live Participation screen, 2026-11-10

rules.says: No 'not X, not Y' lists and no 'we do not …, and we do not …' sentences.
Words the governor has rejected: 'quiet' as copy, 'Fair use', engineering words (route, identity), 'Contact' as the action (it is Message), 'It is free'.
rules.source: handoff §3 Avoid; §7 rejected ('Contact' → 'Message', 'It is free'); journey 08; governor review 2026-11-10

rules.says: Anything drawn as a button or a row with a chevron is a real link, button or summary.
rules.source: correction 24 ('Make an account' looked like a button); part 2 About report row

rules.says: The footer is the colophon: the name, and About. Participation and Privacy live inside About.
rules.source: drawing board (About + Participation + Privacy on one screen); governor review 2026-11-10

rules.says: No band of empty paper under the colophon: below the footer's text only its own padding and, on a phone, the bar's room.
rules.source: governor review of the live screens 2026-11-10 (double padding under the footer)

rules.says: Each screen names itself once, in one h1.
rules.source: foundation: a page names itself in its own heading, once

rules.says: At most one solid ink action is visible on a screen.
rules.source: drawing board: the docked action; journey 11
foundation §10; journey 07 (three pages only before the sweep)

rules.says: A screen reached from inside another (About and its policies, a work, a maker, a Studio sub-page) has Back.
rules.source: governor review 2026-11-10 (Participation had no way back); drawing board screens 2, 3, 6, 14

rules.says: No screen is a wall of prose: no paragraph runs past 75 words.
rules.source: governor 2026-11-09 ('like a doctor's notebook'); review of the live screens 2026-11-10
